sections.label: Plan Documentation & Administrative
sections.summary: Critical deficiencies in foundational plan documentation, including missing approvals, owner authority documentation, sheet organization errors, incomplete data tables, and inconsistent zoning/use terminology. Multiple severity-3 issues prevent plan release.

sections.label: Building Design & Setbacks
sections.summary: Major gaps in architectural documentation and setback verification. Missing elevation sheets and height zone distance analysis create fundamental deficiencies in building design review.

sections.label: Compatibility & Screening
sections.summary: Article 10 compatibility standards analysis is entirely missing, and adjacent property documentation is incomplete. Use designation ambiguity and exterior equipment screening requirements lack documentation.

sections.label: Waste Management & Equipment Screening
sections.summary: No central dumpster facility is shown on plans, and required dumpster documentation (design, setback, cover sheet details) is completely missing. Recycling ordinance compliance also lacks required documentation.

sections.label: Water Quality
sections.summary: Critical water benchmarking application documentation is missing, preventing verification of water conservation compliance and sustainability requirements.

sections.label: Infrastructure & Utilities
sections.summary: Easement and property boundary documentation is incomplete, recorded linework lacks delineation, and multiple departmental approvals remain unconfirmed. Environmental easement conflicts with proposed improvements.

sections.label: Street Trees & Landscaping
sections.summary: Open space definition, dimensions, and delineation are missing across multiple plan sheets, preventing verification of required open space areas and amenities. Landscaping features lack sufficient documentation.

sections.label: Erosion Control & Grading
sections.summary: Topography contour intervals do not meet standards, and erosion hazard zone analysis for the West Bouldin Creek watershed is missing. Impervious cover calculation worksheet is incomplete.
